active_block.intent: Prove whether a learned V2 policy actually produces greater responsible verified value than V1 on comparable real held-out outcomes, while preserving policy identity, owner/project boundaries, authority, receipt lineage, and fail-closed comparison.
acceptance: exact live main HEAD is resolved
V1 and V2 policy identities are captured in canonical execution receipts
both executions use the same frozen experiment case
policy input and decision hashes are preserved
receiver outcomes are independently authenticated and verified
responsible-value inputs are inspectable and deterministically calculated
comparison returns PROVEN only when candidate verified value exceeds baseline under all validity gates
receipt swap and lineage attacks are rejected
policy promotion remains separately governed and cannot be triggered by evaluation alone
fresh Naya can retrieve current state and continue one safe action
active_block.next_action: Build the smallest independent real-outcome/value contract on the existing Smart Mail receipt substrate so receiver-verified outcomes can carry inspectable benefit, harm, cost, and risk-adjusted-loss evidence without hardcoded send-path scoring; then run a frozen multi-case V1/V2 paired experiment and accept only PROVEN or NOT_PROVEN.
